en.t: Oh, I had forgotten. It is the sickle.

units.source_text: 刚才我在路边剥杉树皮来着，看见你就飞跑过来，所以还带着镰刀。”

en.t: Just now I was stripping cedar bark by the roadside. When I saw you, I came running over, so I still had the sickle with me.

units.source_text: 苗子这才觉察到自己腰上的镰刀，“多危险啊。”

en.t: Only then did Naeko notice the sickle at her waist. How dangerous.
